**Update 2:42pm 02/07/2026**

  Works are now complete and supply should begin to return to all affected areas.

Leak detection works may cause supply disruptions to Murvagh, Carrick West, Tullyearl, Killymard, Drumlongaher, Laghey, Donegal town centre and surrounding areas in Co. Donegal.

Works are scheduled to take place from 11pm on 1 July until 5:30am on 3 July.

We recommend that you allow 3-4 hours after the estimated restoration time for your supply to fully return.

Please take note of the following reference number and enter it into the search bar should you wish to return for an update: DON00115128.

LA 01
